thread:
Jaya: hi all, hitting a weird error building the runtime from source on the new dev box (Ubuntu 22.04, RTX 6000 Ada). nvcc/ptxas complaining about 'Unsupported GPU architecture "sm_90"' when linking. any quick checks?

Samir: welcome! first quick ones: run `nvcc --version` and `nvidia-smi` so we know the toolkit vs driver. also which CUDA did you install?

Jaya: nvcc says Cuda compilation tools, release 11.8, V11.8.89. nvidia-smi shows driver 535. nn: CUDA 12+ GPUs but toolkit is 11.8. is that the mismatch?

Nat: yeah that combo explains it — Ada (compute capability 9.0) isn't supported properly by CUDA 11.8 nvcc. pt xas will choke because the build system is emitting sm_90 flags. either upgrade to CUDA 12.x or patch the build to not target sm_90.

Mika: if you can't upgrade the host toolkit, a short-term hack is to strip sm_90 from the arch list in CMakeLists / build config so it falls back to PTX-only or a lower SM (if you accept reduced perf). but prefer upgrading.

Jaya: thanks. how do I change the CMake flag? Found a hardcoded list in cmake/arch.cmake. 

Samir: simplest: set `CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES` in your cmake invocation: `cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES="86;75"` (example). Remove 90 from that list. Or on our repo there's a helper: `scripts/setup-devbox.sh --cuda=12` to use docker image.

Jaya: tried adding 86,75 and re-running, now I get a different error: linker complaining about missing symbol __cudaRegisterFatBinary. looks like mixed objects from different toolkits.

Nat: yep mixed-toolkit objects are messy. Clean your build dir fully (`rm -rf build/*`) and rebuild after changing arch. also `ccache` can bite you — clear it or disable while diagnosing.

Mika: another angle: if you switch to our dev container image (redwood/runtime-dev:cuda12-ubuntu22.04) the environment is pinned. `docker run --rm -it -v $PWD:/src -w /src redwood/runtime-dev:cuda12-ubuntu22.04 bash` then `cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug && cmake --build build -j16`.

Jaya: thanks, trying the docker image now. also saw a compile flag in top-level Makefile `-gencode arch=compute_90,code=sm_90` — should we be changing that too?

Samir: yes if it's hardcoded. we used to have a mapped list per toolkit version. open a quick PR to detect toolkit version and set allowed archs. Happy to review.

build-bot: CI job 4821 queued for branch jaya/cuda-arch-fix (will run after PR opened).

Jaya: docker build worked! had to wipe build dir and disable ccache. compiled and unit tests started. I'll open a tiny PR to make the arch list conditional and add a note to dev docs about requiring CUDA 12+ for Ada GPUs.

Mika: awesome. when you open the PR ping me and Samir for review. also add a short troubleshooting section in docs/dev/onboarding.md about nvcc/toolkit mismatches. saved us a few of these. :tada:

Jaya: will do, thanks everyone. saved my morning.

Samir: welcome aboard, glad it's sorted. hit us up if you run into runtime perf regressions post-upgrade — we have a checklist for debugging kernel selection / quantization flags.

Jaya: noted, thanks!
